title: Patch: a signature animation for every Core Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
thread:
**Issue #3402 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3402: Patch: a signature animation for every Core Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3332, whose signature tier, takeovers for any card, budgets and ratchet these entries use.

The owner asked (2026-11-06) for every Legendary and Mythic to have an animation of its own, as in Hearthstone, instead of one shared animation.

### Today

- Core has 12 Legendaries and Mythics: 7 play a shared motif, 1 plays nothing, and 4 have recipes of their own (Transmogulate's `legendaryTide`, Zephrys's `perfectWish`, Craft a Card's `fusionForge`, Ceaseless Void's `voidFold`); the ones left here that have their own grow into full signatures.

### What it should be

- **Every card gets a signature.** Every card in the table gets a `signature` entry in its set's `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core.json5` table, with its recipe in `apps/web/src/fx/cards/core/`, built from its concept, and leaves `SIGNATURE_PENDING`.
- **The beats by type:**
  - a Unit plays an entrance of its own, then its text's beat;
  - a Spell plays a cast of its own;
  - a permanent plays its arrival, its text's beat, and a standing aura of its own on its tile.
- **A Mythic's takeover is its own,** with its own art filling the screen.
- **A concept is the target, not a script.** The builder keeps each card's idea, and may move a beat to fit the budgets or the events the view carries.
- **The rules every signature keeps:**
  - the signature budgets (#3332), R200, and one set piece per action;
  - reduced motion, speed, intensity and `bigMoments`;
  - never showing a hidden card (R202).
- **Sound.** Each sound is its own, inside the audio budgets.
- **Owned elsewhere** (left out of this table): Ceaseless Void (`core-100`, #3338) and Felinor Fiender (`core-092`, #3332's proof card).

### The concepts

| id | name | rarity | now | entrance or cast | what its text does, shown | on its tile | sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| core-052 | Silly Silas | Legendary | cry: shift motif | Silas pirouettes down a spotlight from the top of the screen, lands heel-first and cracks a ring-shaped crater into his zone, tipping an imaginary hat. | On `rotated`, a mirrorball ring spins the field the chosen way; every card glides one step in a shuffle-step, each crossing sides flipping its border to its new owner's colour on `controlChanged`. | A slow violet-and-teal mirrorball glint sweeping his tile, his toes tapping. | A record scratch, then a quick two-step tap shuffle. |
| core-083 | Transmogulate | Legendary | bespoke legendaryTide | A cracked crucible tips over the caster's hero and a pearl-and-rose alchemical wave crests out of it, glass vials bursting into prismatic sparks. | The wave rolls over the caster's Deck and hand piles on each `transformed`, each hand card crowned with a sheen (owner only); Embiggened, it sweeps their Units too, each re-forming in a ripple. | none | A bubbling crucible, a rising choir swell and glass chimes. |
| core-085 | Unlicensed Experimentation | Legendary | cast: snap motif | On `trapFired` the card bursts open into a floor hatch and robotic clamps lunge out in green arc light under a cackling goggled silhouette. | The clamps seize the permanent just played and drag it along a crackling tether onto the caster's matching permanent; the two weld with a stitched seam and a green flash on `fused`. | none: face-down until it fires (R202), then spent. | A hatch clank, a servo whine and a sizzling welder's arc. |
| core-087 | Pocket Chaos | Legendary | cast: shift motif | A velvet pocket pops open over the board's centre and a tumbling cloud of dice and cards spills out, both hero portraits tugged toward it. | On `swapped`, the chosen pair, hero health, boards or Deck piles, trade places through the pocket in a figure-eight arc; a card-back then drops into the opponent's hand pile on `addedToHand` (face owner only). | none | A zipper rip, rattling dice and a slide-whistle swap. |
| core-093 | Combo-Index | Legendary | cast: conjure; trigger: tally; aura: storm zone | A glass stadium of stacked rings rises out of the zone, a spotlight snapping onto its lowest ring as a card-confetti whirl spirals up. | On `questProgressed` the next ring lights and fires its grade: a card-back to hand (`addedToHand`), tags dropping (`costChanged`), an enemy hand card burning (`exiled`), a spark (`radiantSet`), a Lifesteal beam (`damage`). | Stacked glass rings idling over the zone, the current grade's ring softly lit in storm blue. | A crowd's rising cheer, a stadium horn per grade. |
| core-095 | Call to Chaos (Core Edition) | Legendary | cast: conjure motif | A crystal slot-wheel drops over the board and a cloaked hand yanks its lever; the reels blur in magenta sparks and alarm-bell light. | On `chaosRolled` the reels slam to the rolled effect's icon, shown to both seats, and it bursts out: Units tumbling on `summoned`, a healing fountain, a card shower on `drawn`, or a golem's fist. | none | A lever clunk, whirring reels and a jackpot bell. |
| core-096 | My Pawn | Mythic | cast: snap motif | Takeover on `trapFired`: the screen turns indigo as a vast hooded hand reaches over a glass chessboard, puppet strings snapping taut from its fingertips to every enemy piece. | The lethal attack freezes mid-swing and shatters into silver shards; for the rest of the turn every enemy action, each `summoned`, `damage` or attack, plays with faint strings jerking the card. | none: face-down until it fires (R202); faint strings hang over the enemy hero until the turn ends. | One chess piece's clack, then a slow music-box waltz. |
| core-097 | Zephrys | Mythic | bespoke perfectWish | Takeover: a cyclone of sky-blue silk fills the screen and a towering wind spirit uncoils from it, chin on fist, pondering, as card-backs orbit him. | His eyes snap open; the Discover's options stay with the caster (owner only), and on `addedToHand` one card-back streaks on a gust from the board's far side into the caster's hand pile. | none | A rising wind, a thoughtful hum, then one bright chime. |
| core-098 | Heroic Power | Mythic | cast: conjure; activate: bolt; aura: holy zone | Takeover: the screen becomes a white marble rotunda of thirteen glowing doors; a hero strides through one and the hall folds down into a crystal pedestal on the zone. | The Discover's doors open for the caster alone (owner only). On each `activated`, the pedestal flares in its power's colour and launches it: a dart on `damage`, a sprinter on `summoned`, a card-back on `drawn`. | A crystal pedestal with one slowly turning orb, its power's colour pulsing, an Indestructible diamond glint. | A great door's groan, then a short heroic fanfare. |
| core-099 | Craft a Card | Mythic | bespoke fusionForge | Takeover: a floating crystal forge fills the screen, two glowing rails converging on an anvil under a giant hammer, gears turning overhead in blue sparks. | The two Discovered Units ride the rails as card-backs (owner only); the hammer falls on `fused`, the halves weld in white light, and the card flies into the hand pile on `addedToHand` (face owner only). | none | Two clanking footsteps, an anvil strike and a hiss of steam. |

## Acceptance

- Every card in the table has a `signature` entry and recipe and is off `SIGNATURE_PENDING`. `tables.test.ts`, `tiers.test.ts` and `coverage.test.ts` pass.
- `/dev/fx` shows each signature. A component spec plays every card in the table at desktop size and at 390x844, and `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` covers this group's two heaviest within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`.
- Each Mythic's takeover draws its own art, and reduced motion shows its still form.
- No beat shows a hidden card. A test plays each card with a Discover, a hand or a face-down trap from the opponent's seat.
- The pull request holds the per-card table with each card's verdict. Any ruling is in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
- The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
```
